# Waddat Drinks - Full Brand & Product Documentation

> Waddat Drinks is a beverage brand crafting authentic Jamaican-inspired bottled fruit drinks and sea moss tonics. Rooted in Caribbean family heritage, our recipes use natural ingredients, real fruits, citrus, herbs, and spices, with zero artificial preservatives.

## Table of Contents
1. About Waddat Drinks
2. Brand Heritage & Mission
3. Complete Product Directory
4. Ingredients & Nutritional Information
5. Wholesale, Trade & Stockist Information
6. Contact & Digital Channels

---

## 1. About Waddat Drinks
Waddat Drinks (website: https://waddatdrinks.com) is a beverage maker dedicated to preserving and sharing authentic Caribbean drink recipes. Each bottle reflects genuine Jamaican culinary roots, featuring quality ingredients such as sea moss, real ginger root, sorrel (hibiscus flower calyces), soursop fruit, tropical pineapple, lemon, and honey.

---

## 2. Brand Heritage & Mission
Founded on generational family recipes developed in Jamaica and refined over decades, Waddat Drinks exists to make authentic tropical beverages accessible without compromising on recipe integrity or quality.

Our core principles:
- **Heritage First**: Recipes that stay true to traditional Jamaican methods, such as steeping real sorrel with warming ginger and spices.
- **Natural Quality**: No artificial colorings, artificial preservatives, high fructose corn syrup, or synthetic flavorings.
- **Authentic Caribbean Flavours**: Utilizing real tropical fruits, roots, and ocean sea moss.

---

## 3. Complete Product Directory

### Ginger
- **URL**: https://waddatdrinks.com/product/ginger/
- **Description**: Waddat Ginger brings the bold warmth of ginger together with bright lemon and a mellow touch of honey. Zesty and gently sweet, it starts lively and finishes with a warming kick you’ll want to revisit.
- **Taste Profile**: Bold, warming ginger kick balanced by citrus brightness and mellow honey.
- **Key Ingredients**: Ginger, lemon, honey, filtered water.
- **Format**: 330ml bottle. Enjoy chilled. Shake well before drinking.

### Sorrel
- **URL**: https://waddatdrinks.com/product/sorrel-drink/
- **Description**: Waddat Sorrel bursts with tangy sorrel, warming ginger and bright lemon, bringing a lively twist to a Jamaican favourite. Sweet, tart and spiced, it delivers a refreshing sip with a ginger finish worth coming back for.
- **Taste Profile**: Deep ruby infusion; sweet, tart, and spiced with a vibrant ginger finish.
- **Key Ingredients**: Sorrel (hibiscus), ginger, lemon, sugar, filtered water.
- **Format**: 330ml bottle. Vegan friendly. Enjoy chilled. Shake well before drinking.

### Lemonade
- **URL**: https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Lemonade/
- **Description**: Waddat Lemonade pairs the lively tang of lemon with mellow honey, turning a familiar favourite into a refreshing escape. Bright and gently sweet, it opens with citrus zing and settles into a smooth finish worth revisiting.
- **Taste Profile**: Crisp, refreshing lemon citrus rounded with smooth honey sweetness.
- **Key Ingredients**: Lemon, honey, filtered water.
- **Format**: 330ml bottle. Enjoy chilled. Shake well before drinking.

### Pineapple Sea Moss
- **URL**: https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Pineapple-Sea-Moss/
- **Description**: Waddat Pineapple Sea Moss blends tropical pineapple sweetness with nutrient-rich sea moss, creating a smooth, refreshing Jamaican-inspired drink.
- **Taste Profile**: Tropical sweetness of golden pineapple balanced with ocean sea moss and mellow honey.
- **Key Ingredients**: Pineapple, sea moss, lemon, honey, filtered water.
- **Format**: 330ml bottle. Naturally sweetened with honey. Enjoy chilled. Shake well before drinking.

### Soursop Sea Moss
- **URL**: https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Soursop-Sea-Moss/
- **Description**: Waddat Soursop Sea Moss blends soursop’s soft tropical sweetness with sea moss, lifted by bright lemon and honey. Softly sweet with a tropical tang, it finishes with a citrus lift for a taste worth savouring.
- **Taste Profile**: Smooth tropical soursop flavour with a gentle citrus lift and honey undertones.
- **Key Ingredients**: Soursop, sea moss, lemon, honey, filtered water.
- **Format**: 330ml bottle. Naturally sweetened with honey. Enjoy chilled. Shake well before drinking.

---

## 4. Ingredients & Nutritional Information
- **Real Ingredients**: Crafted with real ginger root, sorrel (hibiscus), cold-pressed lemon juice, pineapple, soursop fruit, and Caribbean sea moss.
- **Naturally Sweetened**: Sweetened with honey or cane sugar as specified on each bottle label; no high-fructose corn syrup or artificial sweeteners.
- **No Artificial Additives**: Free from artificial preservatives, artificial colors, and synthetic flavorings.
- **Dietary Considerations**: Sorrel is vegan-friendly; Ginger, Lemonade, Pineapple Sea Moss, and Soursop Sea Moss contain honey.
- **Serving Suggestion**: Best served chilled. Natural separation is normal—shake well before drinking. Keep refrigerated once opened.

---

## 5. Wholesale, Trade & Stockist Information
Waddat Drinks partners with retailers, independent delis, health food stores, restaurants, cafes, bars, and food service operators across the UK and internationally.

- **Trade Brochure**: Downloadable directly at https://waddatdrinks.com/Waddat%20Beverage%20Trade%20Brochure%202.pdf
- **Wholesale Contact Form**: Accessible at https://waddatdrinks.com/#wholesale
- **Bottle Format**: 330ml bottles suitable for ambient or chilled display.
- **Trade Inquiries**: Direct wholesale enquiries can be submitted online via the website wholesale enquiry form.
